lines.en: What kind of race do the children compete in?
lines.cn: 孩子们参加的是什么样的比赛呢？

lines.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
lines.cn: 实验已经证明，儿童可以在非常年幼的时候就开始学习游泳。

lines.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,
lines.cn: 在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，

lines.en: children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
lines.cn: 孩子们甚至在还不会走路的时候，就已经能够熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。

lines.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
lines.cn: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒进入水中。

lines.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
lines.cn: 没过多久，他们就习惯了游泳，甚至能够从泳池底部捡起重物了。

lines.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
lines.cn: 在这些年轻游泳运动员中非常受欢迎的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

lines.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
lines.cn: 三轮车被整齐地排列在水池底部——那里的水深达七英尺。

lines.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
lines.cn: 孩子们互相竞争，看谁能第一个游到泳池的另一端。

lines.en: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
lines.cn: 很多人骑着他们的三轮车，但大多数人更喜欢推着或拉着它们前进。

lines.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
lines.cn: 有些孩子可以在游泳池里游完整个距离，而且一次都不需要停下来喘气。

lines.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
lines.cn: 他们是否能够成为未来的奥运冠军，只有时间才能告诉我们。

lines.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
lines.cn: 与此同时，他们应该鼓励我们当中那些连五码都游不了、一游就会喘不过气来的人。
